en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left, buildings and a villa-like structure stand at the foot of a wooded hill, with a castle-style structure labeled as Geipelburg further along the bank. A cobbled path runs beside the river, where a lone figure walks. On the right, a river steamer with a tall smokestack moves along the water, and in the distance a metal truss bridge spans the river, with a town and church towers on the far bank. Red printed text at the top identifies the location, and a publisher credit with date appears at the bottom.
